## Put repeated topology behind one boundary

Rebuilding the same parallel LC in every Plan is noisy and exposes internals
that consumers should not wire directly. A `CompositePlan` solves that reuse
problem: a custom `Library` factory declares child components, public
`ParameterSpec`s, ground, and exposed pins, then returns one immutable
`ComponentInstance`. Read the complete adjacent
[catalog fixture](fixtures/resonator_library.py) alongside the
[Composite reuse boundary](../../docs/concepts/physical-authority-and-reusable-composition.qmd#composite-as-reuse-boundary).

The package publishes one clearly named object—`resonator_library.components`—
instead of asking users to alias several objects named `library`.

## Create and inspect the public component

The factory call below is the whole consumer-facing construction surface.
Hidden capacitor, inductor, internal node, and ground grouping remain catalog
implementation evidence.

```{python}
#| id: create-custom-composite
from fixtures import resonator_library
from scnsim import units as u

resonator = resonator_library.components.parallel_linear_lc_resonator(
    id="resonator",
    capacitance=110.0 * u.fF,
    inductance=5.8 * u.nH,
)
resonator.parameter("capacitance").show()
resonator.pin("terminal")
```
